criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Issues
categories.definition: Inquiries related to problems with physical or virtual cards, including activation, blocking, and PIN issues.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests for changes or updates to account details, including name changes and account deletion.

categories.name: Transaction Inquiries
categories.definition: Questions regarding the status, processing, or issues related to transactions, including transfers and refunds.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Concerns related to the process of verifying identity for account access or transactions.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Inquiries about fees associated with transactions, card usage, or account services.

categories.name: Top-Up and Funding
categories.definition: Questions about adding funds to accounts, including methods and limits for top-ups.

categories.name: Money Transfers
categories.definition: Requests for information on sending or receiving money, including methods and issues with transfers.

categories.name: Exchange Rates and Currency Conversion
categories.definition: Inquiries about exchange rates, currency conversion, and related fees.

categories.name: ATM Issues
categories.definition: Concerns related to ATM transactions, including withdrawals, declines, and machine malfunctions.

categories.name: Refund Requests
categories.definition: Requests for information or action regarding refunds for transactions.

categories.name: Virtual Card Usage
categories.definition: Questions specifically about the use and functionality of disposable or virtual cards.

categories.name: Security Concerns
categories.definition: Inquiries related to potential fraud, unauthorized transactions, or account security.

categories.name: Delivery and Timing
categories.definition: Questions about the timing of card deliveries, transaction processing, and transfer durations.

categories.name: General Banking Questions
categories.definition: General inquiries about banking services, policies, and account features.
